_comment: A batch with failures (owner, 2026-10-13): one failed file does not stop the others; a failure is printed when it happens (the file as the plan names it, then the reason's first line); at the end the counts, the time the batch took and the total size of what it left, no per-output list. Both runtimes print the same text, on stderr, so stdout (the parsed result) is unchanged. Sizes count 1024 bytes to the KB, one decimal; under 1 KB in bytes. Python `knaif.batch_chain.failure_line` / `summary_line`, Rust `knaif_core::batch_chain`.
